newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Earthquake rocks Taiwan, no casualties reported.
newsitem.headline: Earthquake rocks Taiwan, no casualties reported.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 5.3 on the open-ended Richter scale struck eastern and northern Taiwan early on Monday, but there were no immediate reports of casualties or damage.

A Central Weather Bureau statement said the quake's epicentre was 26.1 km (16.3 miles) southeast of Taiwan's northeastern coastal city of Ilan and some 63.5 km (39.7 miles) beneath the earth's surface.
There were no immediate reports of casualties or damage from the tremor, an interior ministry spokesman said by telephone.
The quake was felt in the capital Taipei where buildings swayed and in most parts of the island's eastern and northern region.
